desc: E3 fixture: a program spanning two repositories, authored so the declared edge count is EXACT.
note: HAND-AUTHORED FIXTURE, NEVER REGENERATED. The declared-edge count E3 asserts is a property of this file plus its sibling warehouse-window.json.
